guideTitle: Best Stackable Compact Washer and Dryer Sets (2026)
metaTitle: Best Stackable Compact Washer Dryer Sets
metaDescription: Five stackable compact washer and dryer sets compared on drum sizes, vented drying, power connection, stacking hardware and what each needs from a closet.
expertTake: The Equator EW 822 and ED 866 pair is the pick for most buyers because its Direct Line power connection and 3.1 cu ft dryer make a clean closet install on ordinary household power. The Equator ultra compact set is the value choice for tight spaces. Anyone with a gas line and a full laundry closet should look past this class at a tall stacked tower, which gives far more capacity.
introParagraphs: A stackable set puts the dryer directly on top of the washer so two machines occupy the floor of one. In a closet, an alcove or a galley kitchen, that vertical arrangement is often the only way to get a real washer and a real dryer into the same home.

Stacking only works when the machines are designed for it. The cabinets must match in width and depth, a kit must lock the dryer to the washer and the whole tower must stand on a floor that can carry it. This guide picks sets built for that job and explains what each one asks of your install.

products.name: Equator compact stackable washer EW 822 1.57 cu ft and dryer ED 866 3.1 cu ft 110V white

specList.label: Programs
specList.value: Normal, Heavy, Quick 20, ECO, Wool and more

products.description:
The standout feature of this pair is its Direct Line power system: the washer plugs directly into the dryer, so the stack needs one wall outlet instead of two and one fewer cord to route behind the closet. The washer is a 1.57 cu ft front loader with 15 programs, including Normal, Heavy, Quick 20, ECO and Wool, and the dryer is a 3.1 cu ft unit that is more than twice the washer's drum.

That ratio matters because a dryer with room to tumble dries faster and more evenly than a cramped drum. The washer's small drum caps what you can wash, so the pair suits a couple or a small family, and bulky bedding goes to a laundromat. Against the ultra compact set it offers a larger dryer at a modest step up.

Plan the install in this order: a level, stiff floor, a vent path for the dryer, the stacking hardware and then the washer's water and drain connections. Check the Direct Line cord routing so it is never pinched when the tower is pushed back, and clean the lint screen every load. As the washer draws power through the dryer, a fault in one cord affects both machines, so inspect the connection for heat or discoloration once a year. When you pull the stack out for cleaning, lift the dryer off first with a helper rather than sliding the pair together, which can strain the stacking brackets.
products.bestFor: Closets with one outlet and a vent path that need a matched stack on household power.

products.name: Equator ultra compact stackable washer and dryer set 1.6 cu ft and 2.6 cu ft 110V

specList.label: Dryer cycles
specList.value: Sensor Dry, Air Dry, Warm, Hot, Timed

products.description:
This ultra compact set trims the dryer to 2.6 cu ft and keeps the 1.57 cu ft washer, with a 110V supply suited to apartments, condos, RVs and vacation homes. The dryer is vented and offers Sensor Dry, Air Dry, Warm, Hot and Timed Dry, so it can stop when clothes are dry rather than running a fixed timer.

The washer's 15 programs include Sanitize, Allergen, PET and Baby, which are useful for households with pets or infants. The smaller dryer is the compromise: it will not take everything the washer can produce in one go, so large washes dry in two batches.

It is the better choice for very tight closets and for installs where every inch of height counts. Mind the vent run, keep the lint screen clean and check that your floor is level and strong enough for a stacked pair before you commit. Use the dryer's Sensor Dry for everyday loads and the Timed Dry only for items you know dry slowly, since a sensor cycle usually saves time and avoids baking clothes. Keep a small brush near the unit to clear the lint trap housing, where fine lint collects past the screen and eventually restricts airflow.
products.bestFor: Very small closets and second homes that need a stacked pair with sensor drying.
pros: Sensor Dry stops when clothes are dry
Allergen, Baby and PET wash programs
110V operation
Smaller overall height than larger sets
cons: 2.6 cu ft dryer is smaller than the EW 822 pair's

products.name: Equator Premium stackable 15 lb washer 1.62 cu ft EW 826 with 3.5 cu ft vented dryer ED 852

specList.label: Stacking
specList.value: Designed to stack for space saving

products.description:
The Premium pair gives you the largest dryer here, a 3.5 cu ft vented unit with a digital control, atop a 15 lb, 1.62 cu ft washer. The washer adds four memory programs so your most frequent cycles are one touch away, and a Pet cycle designed to remove the maximum amount of pet fur in one pass. Both machines are designed to stack for maximum space saving.

What that bigger dryer buys you is practical: you can dry a full washer load in one cycle with room to spare, and bulky items like towels dry more evenly. The cost is height, since a larger dryer makes a taller stack, so measure your ceiling and any shelf above the closet before ordering.

Ownership centers on the memory programs and the vent. Set the cycles you use most, route the exhaust duct without sags and clean the lint screen after every load. A level base is essential because the dryer's mass sits on the washer's cabinet. Use the memory programs to lock in a quick cycle for everyday clothes and a longer one for towels, so the people who share the machine do not need to read the dial each time. Re-check the stacking brackets after the first month, since new hardware settles and a loose bracket is the first sign of a tower that will start to vibrate.
products.bestFor: Households that want a roomier dryer on a compact washer.
pros: 3.5 cu ft vented dryer is the largest here
Four memory programs on the washer

Digital dryer control
cons: 1.62 cu ft washer drum is modest

products.name: Splendide WFL2500X washer and DV1725X dryer stacked bundle with vent kit and SK04 stack kit

specList.label: Kits
specList.value: Vent kit and SK04 stack kit

specList.label: Extras
specList.value: Auto winterization, Tub Fresh, reversible door

products.description:
This bundle arrives with the pieces that other stacks leave to you: a vent kit and an SK04 stack kit, plus a washer and dryer designed for RV and compact living. The dryer has 15 drying cycles with Opti Sensor moisture detection that stops the cycle when clothes are dry, and the listing mentions smartphone app compatibility and digital displays.

The washer adds an automatic winterization cycle and a Tub Fresh drum cleaning function, both of which help owners who store a coach or a second home. The dryer door is reversible, a small feature that makes a big difference in a tight closet where the door must swing the other way.

The tradeoff is that the listing gives little capacity data in the text we reviewed, so confirm drum sizes before you commit. Plan the stack carefully, use the supplied kit and vent kit, and run the Tub Fresh cycle monthly. Before storing a coach for the winter, run the winterization cycle as the manual describes so water is cleared from the pump and lines, and leave the door open so the drum can dry out. Ask the seller to confirm drum sizes in writing, because they are the first thing a compact stack buyer needs to know.
products.bestFor: RV and second-home owners who want kits included and a winterization cycle.

products.name: Samsung Bespoke AI Laundry Hub 4.6 cu ft washer with 7.6 cu ft gas dryer single unit

specList.label: Washer
specList.value: 4.6 cu ft front load with steam wash

products.description:
This is the odd one out: not a compact set but a full-size laundry hub that stacks a front-load washer and a gas dryer into one factory-built unit. The 4.6 cu ft washer offers steam wash and the 7.6 cu ft dryer burns gas. An AI Smart Dial learns your favorite cycles and recommends them.

It earns a place here because many people who search for stackable sets are really choosing between a compact stack and a full-size tower. The Hub gives you far more capacity than any compact pair, at the cost of a bigger footprint, a gas line and a much higher price tier.

If you have the space and the gas, it is the simplest way to get full-size laundry in a vertical footprint. A professional should connect the gas, and the install needs a stiff floor and a short, straight vent.

buyingCriteria.explanation: A dryer must lock onto the washer with a kit made for both models, otherwise it can walk during a spin. The Equator sets are designed to stack and the Splendide bundle includes its SK04 stack kit. Never stack machines from different makers or sizes, and never rely on the weight of the dryer alone to hold it in place.

A stacked pair puts the combined weight of two machines and a wet load on one patch of floor. Level the washer first, then stack, and check that a closet floor with thin plywood is reinforced. A tower on a bouncy floor will shake the whole closet during the spin.

buyingCriteria.criterion: Dryer size compared with the washer
buyingCriteria.explanation: The Equator EW 822 pair pairs a 1.57 cu ft washer with a 3.1 cu ft dryer, and the Premium pair a 1.62 cu ft washer with a 3.5 cu ft dryer. A larger dryer drum dries faster because clothes have room to tumble. Choose the biggest dryer your closet height allows.

Every compact stack here uses a vented dryer, which needs a duct to the outside or a window kit. The Splendide bundle includes a vent kit, which is a real saver. Keep the duct short and straight to dry quickly and avoid lint buildup.

The Equator EW 822 pair uses a Direct Line system so the washer plugs into the dryer and the stack needs one outlet. Other pairs need two outlets and cords. In a closet with a single outlet, that detail decides the install.

A taller dryer makes a taller tower, and a shelf or a soffit above the closet can block it. Measure from the floor to the lowest obstruction before ordering, and leave a few inches for the vent connection at the back.

maintenance.task: Check the stacking kit and leveling
maintenance.why: Vibration loosens fasteners. A level, secure stack runs quietly and stays put.
Lint blocks airflow and is a fire risk. It is the single most important habit.
Kinks and lint slow drying. A short straight duct dries faster and safer.
Detergent residue builds behind the drum. A clean cycle removes it.
Moisture in the gasket grows mold. A wipe and an open door prevent it.

faq.q: Can I stack any compact washer and dryer?
faq.a: No. The two must be designed to stack and joined by the correct kit. The Equator and Splendide sets are built for it. Mixing makers is unsafe.

faq.q: How much do stackable sets cost?
faq.a: Prices move with listings, but the ultra compact Equator set sits at the lower end and the Hub at the top. Budget for a vent kit, a stack kit and delivery. A cheaper set that needs extra parts may cost the same in the end.
They can, because the dryer sits above the washer. A level base and a firm floor help. Avoid overloading and unbalanced washes.

faq.q: Do I need a vent for the dryer?
faq.a: The compact vented dryers here do. A short duct to the outside or a window kit is required. Ventless options exist but are not in this lineup.

faq.q: Can I use these in an RV?
faq.a: The Splendide bundle targets RV use and includes a winterization cycle. The Equator sets suit seasonal homes. Check power and vent options for your coach.
A kinked duct, a full lint screen or an overloaded drum are the usual causes. Clear the duct and clean the screen first. Make sure the drum has room to tumble.
